name: booking
description: A personal booking page: share one short link, people book a free time, and ForkMesh emails both of you the details.

interface.shortDescription: Share a link people use to book meetings.
interface.longDescription: Share one short link to your calendar. People see only your free times, pick one and book; the meeting goes on your ForkMesh calendar and ForkMesh emails both of you the details, a reminder the day before, and any change.
defaultPrompt: Who have I got meetings with this week?
How much of next week is booked?
